title: centaurea attica subsp. pateraea
intro: Centaurea attica subsp. pateraea, commonly known as Pateraea cornflower or Attica cornflower, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. It is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Centaurea attica subsp. pateraea include reducing inflammation and improving wound healing, possibly due to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The exact bioactive constituents and their specific therapeutic actions require further research to confirm their effects.
